title: Local Business Resource Center | Yelp for Business

facts.fact: Yelp's vendor page says its Yelp Business Page product offers more than 20 free tools to showcase a business.
facts.quote: Yelp Business Page 20+ free tools to showcase your business

facts.fact: Yelp states that getting a business on Yelp is free, easy, and takes only a few minutes.
facts.quote: Ready to get your business on Yelp? It’s free, easy, and only takes a few minutes.

facts.fact: The Yelp for Business page footer gives the copyright range for Yelp Inc. as 2004–2026.
Yelp says its Yelp for Business app is available for iOS and Android.
facts.quote: Go mobile with the [Yelp for Business app](https://business.yelp.com/business-mobile-app/) for iOS and Android.
